title: shutdown: explain deferred driver installation progress
description:
The shutdown helper now reports when deferred driver updates are being
installed, using the existing progress/Plymouth integration together with
explicit local console output. Driver-only runs use driver-specific wording,
while InstallOnShutdown=true retains general unattended-upgrade wording.

The implementation also distinguishes starting the shutdown child from confirmed
installation progress and checks the child exit status before reporting success.
Missing Plymouth or unavailable console output does not interrupt the upgrade.
commit_message: shutdown: explain deferred driver installation progress
